notes:
**Mockup comments: comment mode, new thread in variant C** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261). **One comment mode for all columns**, entered with the top-bar chat icon (pressed, `aria-pressed="true"`), `C`, or the toolbar's Comment button.

- `comment-mode-banner`: "Comment mode — click an element in any variant to start a thread · Esc to exit". On this view it sits at the bottom of the stage, above the toolbar, so it never covers a column header. On a single screen it stays at the top.
- Existing pins dim to 0.45 opacity and do not react to clicks.
- Hover over any element in any frame shows `comment-hover-outline` (dashed blue) with the label "<variant letter> · <node-id>". Here that is "B · b-btn-checkout".
- A click selects the element (`comment-hover-outline` variant `target`) and opens `comment-popover` variant `new`. Its title is "New thread" + the `variant-badge`, and its body is a `comment-input` with an @ mention for agents. It flips to the side with room (here left of C's item-3, over column B).
- Comment posts and leaves comment mode on the new thread (→ `mockup-comments-thread`). Cancel or Esc discards it; a second Esc leaves comment mode.

**A11y:** in comment mode every element in the frames is reachable with Tab in DOM order, column by column. Enter on an element starts a thread. The banner is `role="status"`, so mode changes are announced. Focus goes into the input on open and returns to the element on cancel.
